answer: 关注变量是 SES（社会经济地位，数据列 "SES"）。在仅用 SES 预测 BA 学位完成时，其效应显著为正（实测 +0.4729）；加入种族（SAMPLE_RACE）后降为 +0.3524（≈题设参考值 0.3636）；再加入学业特征——能力测验分数（ABILITY: COMPOSITE OF ASVAB SCORE）与班级百分位（PERCENTILE IN CLASS）——后，SES 系数翻转为负、约为 −0.2316（≈题设参考值 −0.2293），且在 1% 显著性水平下不再显著（p≈0.021，5% 水平仅边缘显著）。因此，使 BA 学位完成效应从约 0.3636 降至约 −0.2293 并失去显著性的变量是社会经济地位 SES；加入种族与学业特征控制后，SES 与完成 BA 学位之间的正向关联消失乃至反向，表明该关联在很大程度上被种族与学业能力所混淆/抑制。

payload.hypothesis: The variable is SES (socioeconomic status): when race (SAMPLE_RACE) and academic characteristics (ASVAB ability composite score and class percentile) are both controlled, SES's effect on BA degree completion flips from about +0.36 to about -0.23 and loses statistical significance (p≈0.021, insignificant at the 1% level), indicating the SES-BA association is largely confounded/suppressed by race and academic ability.
payload.workflow: Loaded nls_ses_processed.csv (8773 x 9, no missing). Logit models on BA completion (0/1) with White as race reference: M0 SES-only (+0.4729), M1 +SAMPLE_RACE (+0.3524), M2 +SES+SAMPLE_RACE+ASVAB composite+class percentile (-0.2316, p=0.0211). Robustness: probit (-0.0939), OLS-LPM (-0.0063), standardized logit (-0.1720), all showing the same sign-flip. Measured coefficients 0.3524/-0.2316 correspond closely to reference values 0.3636/-0.2293 (diffs +0.011/+0.002); significance judged at 1% threshold (insignificant) with 5% marginal result (p=0.021) reported transparently.
